justifications.decision: Compound relation and syntactic attachment of rāga-dveṣa-viyuktaiḥ
options_considered: A tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa adjective of the senses, with rāga-dveṣa as an internal dvandva
justifications.chosen: rāga-dveṣa-viyuktaiḥ qualifies indriyaiḥ: the senses are separated from the pair attraction and aversion; rāga-dveṣa is an internal dvandva, and the whole compound is a tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa adjective.

evidence.translation: prasāda is serenity/clarity, health or soundness

translation:
But one whose inner organ (antaḥ-karaṇa) is obedient to his will,
while encountering unavoidable sense-objects
with senses free from attraction and aversion (rāga-dveṣa) and under his own control,
attains serenity (prasāda).
one_shot_delta: A commentary-blind rendering might take prasāda as “grace” or “favor,” but Śaṅkara defines it as prasannatā and svāsthya, serene clarity and soundness.
It might translate viṣayān caran as free indulgence in sense-objects; Śaṅkara restricts the objects as avarjanīyān and glosses caran as upalabhamānaḥ, “experiencing/encountering.”
It might render vidheyātmā vaguely as “self-controlled” or “obedient soul”; Śaṅkara specifies a bahuvrīhi, whose ātman is the antaḥ-karaṇa and is subject at will.
It might attach rāga-dveṣa-viyuktaiḥ to the person rather than to the senses; the commentary explicitly construes the separation-from-rāga-and-dveṣa with śrotrādibhir indriyair.
analyzer_disagreements: ByT5 segmented rāga-dveṣa-viyuktaiḥ into rāga + dveṣa + viyuktaiḥ; I analyze the inflected word as the neuter instrumental plural of the whole compound stem rāgadveṣaviyukta, supported by the commentary’s tābhyāṃ viyuktaiḥ … indriyair.
ByT5 treated ātma-vaśyaiḥ only as ātma + vaśyaiḥ; I record the whole compound stem ātmavaśya and its ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣa relation from Śaṅkara’s ātmano vaśyāni.
ByT5 split vidheyātmā as vidheya + ātmā; Śaṅkara’s yasya saḥ gloss requires a single bahuvrīhi stem vidheyātman, nominative masculine singular.
ByT5 lemmatized adhigacchati as adhigam; per the requested format I normalize this to bare root gam with prefix adhi.
open_questions: The opening commentary lemma is printed “rāga-dveṣa-viyuktai”; I have treated this as a defective or sandhi-truncated citation of rāga-dveṣa-viyuktaiḥ and have not used that form as morphological evidence.
mula: rāga-dveṣa-viyuktais tu viṣayān indriyaiś caran | ātma-vaśyair vidheyātmā prasādam adhigacchati
commentary_lines: rāga-dveṣa-viyuktai rāgaś ca dveṣaś ca rāga-dveṣau, tat-puraḥsarā hi indriyāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ svābhāvikī, tatra yo mumukṣuḥ bhavati saḥ tābhyāṃ viyuktaiḥ śrotrādibhir indriyair viṣayān avarjanīyān caran upalabhamānaḥ ātma-vaśyair ātmano vaśyāni vaśībhūtāni indriyāṇi tair ātma-vaśyair vidheyātmā icchātaḥ vidheya ātmā antaḥ-karaṇaṃ yasya so 'yaṃ prasādam adhigacchati |
